name: SalesHive

rows.ours: Published monthly base fees plus $100 per qualified booked meeting. Basic vendor bills are extra.
rows.theirs: Custom-quoted flat monthly managed-service fee, rather than per-meeting billing.

rows.ours: Email and LinkedIn outreach, with targeting, replies and qualified booking handled for you.
rows.theirs: Starter covers phone; Growth and Crush add email. US-based and offshore SDR options.

rows.ours: An email-led meeting-booking service. We do not provide a dedicated cold-calling team.
rows.theirs: Strategist, SDR coverage, platform and data included in the managed program.

rows.ours: Standard and Express: 20 qualified meetings in 30 days from campaign launch, or we work for free. Basic is excluded.
rows.theirs: States that it does not guarantee a fixed number of meetings.

rows.ours: Express: day 3 after payment, required inputs and approvals are complete, using prewarmed domains and mailboxes.
rows.theirs: Describes a typical launch of about three weeks, depending on approvals and campaign readiness.

rows.ours: Basic: you buy the domains, mailboxes and tools and share access. Standard and Express: we buy and manage them.
rows.theirs: Managed sending infrastructure, authentication and separate outreach domains.

research_notes: Verified official pricing, email outreach and appointment-setting pages. Do not invent a dollar retainer or percentage savings. The pricing page explicitly distinguishes flat billing from per-meeting billing and explicitly disclaims a fixed meeting guarantee. Typical launch timing is not a contractual SLA; Express has a different, conditional starting clock. SalesHive includes managed tooling and data, so do not imply its quoted fee requires buying those again. Its page describes both month-to-month cancellation notice and annual options; do not simplify that to cancel-any-time or a required annual term. No evidence of clients switching between agencies is supplied.
decision: For B2B teams with sales-call capacity that want email-led qualified booking and published plan fees, present The Revenue Inbox as the focused choice. A dedicated phone-led SDR team is a different scope. Keep this page a direct comparison with no other vendors.
